StoryMissionCfg.Story: <outline color=#000000 width=4><color=#ffffff>Fiancée kidnapped by [Time-Space Bully], I must evolve to <color=#fc0e01>{1}</c> within <color=#fc0e01>{0}</c> to save her!</c></outline>

<outline color=#000000 width=4><color=#ffffff>The black hand finally emerges, but I'm still too weak. I must evolve to <color=#fc0e01>{1}</c> within <color=#fc0e01>{0}</c> to save my fiancée!</c></outline>
StoryMissionCfg.StoryTitle: The Black Hand behind the scenes!

StoryCfg.Talk: (Voice weak) Darling, I'm so scared~~~ Save me~
(Mocking) Oh, look who's here? Don't waste your effort, kid. She's mine now, hahaha~

StoryCfg.Button: (Gritting teeth) I will definitely save you!

StoryCfg.Talk: Hahaha, what will you use to save her with those weak soldiers?
In three days I'll offer her to our Emperor. You're welcome to attend the wedding banquet! Hahahahaha~

StoryCfg.Button: Darling! Wait for me to save you!

StoryCfg.Talk: Oh? You're that tribe chief? In just a few days, not bad progress

StoryCfg.Button: That monster was defeated before, who are you?

StoryCfg.Talk: (Voice weak) Darling, you're far from his match, run!
Want to run after ruining my wedding? Too naive
I'll burn my [Ancient Bloodline] to block him! Run!
Burning bloodline? You think this can always stop me?
At most three days, then you'll perish completely. After that they'll have to submit to me!
